_comment: The world's activation index (world_entities_matching): a record's keys are its name, aliases and keywords, each normalised (accents dropped, case folded, anything not a letter or digit a single space) and kept when 2 to 8 words and 2 or more characters; a key written as a regular expression (/…/) is left out; an always-active record also has the key "*". A text matches a key when the key is one of its word n-grams (1 to 8 words), as the text is normalised the same way.

keys.name: name, aliases and keywords, each once; a regex and a one-letter key left out
an always-active record also answers "*"; a key over 8 words is left out

record.name: The Emperor
aliases: one two three four five six seven eight nine

matches.name: whole words only, any case, a multi-word key in order
matches.text: Old Tam pours. Tamsin waits at the Rusty Anchor's door.
